title: Bounded SLD score turns reconstruction loss into commutator energy

statement.quantifiers: For any finite-dimensional trace-one ensemble rho_x with mean sigma>0, [rho_x,sigma]=0 EVERY x, ANY CPTP Phi with Kraus A_i, and EVERY public scalar A>0.
statement.assertion: With e=int T(rho_x,Phi rho_x), L_x=sigma^-1/2 rho_x sigma^-1/2, G_x=L_x(A+L_x)^-1, B_i=A_i sqrt(sigma): A sum_i int ||[G_x,B_i]||_HS^2 <= (5/2)e. No output commutation, covariance, unitality, reference preservation, dimension or largest-likelihood factor.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional measurable ensemble with common strictly positive mean.
Source states commute with mean; output xi=Phi(sigma) may be singular/noncommuting.
Half-trace error and identical source/output Hilbert space as stated.

inputs: Source ensemble, analytic mean, reconstruction channel; bounded effect witnesses used in proof.
outputs: Operational lower-bound Dirichlet energy for rank-Q hybrid composite Kraus refinements.
interface.precision: Exact finite matrix identity; no archive precision/compiler supplied.
costs: Gprime is an analytic Sylvester witness, not a decoder acquisition oracle.
Arbitrary classical outcomes allowed in converse through closed Choi Schmidt-number cone; upper labels separately charged.

proof_mechanism: On supp xi solve Mprime Gprime+Gprime Mprime=2rho_prime and extend by zero; 0<=Gprime<=I.
Exact positive deficit J=sum_i Tr D_i M D_i^dag and full-space regret R=Tr Mprime(Gprime-G)^2.
Source commutation and scalar A[t/(A+t)]^2<=t/4 bound average mean correction by e/4; J+R<=5e/4.
Triangle estimate contributes factor two; retain support cross terms.
obstructions: Cropping G to output support deletes essential positive cross terms.
Accuracy on rho_x does not imply accuracy on artificial sigma G_x experiment.
Different means cannot share one score argument; arbitrary noncommuting means not covered.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Construct destination ensemble commuting with its actual mean and acquire a geometric energy-to-rank inequality.
Establish source score/covering contracts; this lemma alone is not a broadcasting-to-EB theorem.

generalisations.hypothesis: Extend to noncommuting source means with a different controlled reference score.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
